pattern.name: Canter pleats
pattern.description: Three unequal wind-fold panels lean and taper through the viewfinder. Long open curves with offset creases create the rhythm of a canter without repeating the zebra stripe stencil or a feather motif.

background.status: Designed presentation for the owner-delegated redesign batch; independent of native artwork and product UI colors.

framing.note: Uniform 90% bottom-right-anchored placement protects the complete ears, mane tips, muzzle, and external bird. The existing natural equine shoulder continues to both lower boundaries without a painted extension or an exposed internal cut.

matte.calibrationNote: Native exterior samples are near-white rather than pure white. Border-connected extraction uses a source-specific matte sample; enclosed eye highlights and warm ivory anatomy are protected by connectivity and chroma. No connected-component cleanup is applied in this pass; inspect every remaining component and both light/dark boundaries.
